messages:
AlexW: noticed CI is failing on a bunch of PRs with keystore decrypt errors, alert triggered at ~08:10 UTC
JayOps: grabbing logs now, saw the keystore-agent heartbeat stopped around 02:30 UTC, weirdly coincides with a KMS key rebind yesterday night
MariaG: are these the SAST evidence attacher failures? we had a batch of scans run at 06:00 and attachments never uploaded
SamirS: yes — DAST and SAST run, scan results created but the artifact upload step fails with `KMS: Decrypt failed`
AlexW: stack trace excerpt: ```
ERROR main: attach_evidence: decrypt error: AccessDeniedException: Caller is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:...:key/abc123
```
NatalieC: that smells like RBAC change on the service account used by the runner. Did anyone rotate the keystore SA key or change KMS IAM bindings? :eyes:
JayOps: I checked IAM audit events — there was a role update for `ci-runner@redwood-ci` at 02:15 by infra-automation-bot (chore/rotate-keys). The automation log shows it attempted to update key policy but returned 200 with warnings
MariaG: sec-bot, can you attach the KMS audit log link?
sec-bot: https://console.aws.amazon.com/cloudtrail/home?region=us-west-2#/events?id=1234567890 — role_change event at 2024-04-21T02:15:12Z (actor infra-automation-bot) :mag:
SamirS: quick triage plan: 1) stop CI attachers from retrying (to avoid noise), 2) create a temporary ephemeral grant for `ci-runner@redwood-ci`, 3) reconcile key policy and RBAC, 4) backfill missing evidence once decrypt works
AlexW: I can add a temporary feature flag to disable auto-retry in the attach step — patching now, ETA 10m
JayOps: creating ephemeral grant with CLI: ```aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/keystore-main --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/ci-runner --operations Decrypt```
JayOps: created grant id: GRANT-0a1b2c3d, granted until 2024-04-22T03:00:00Z — please test
SamirS: re-ran one of the failing jobs manually, attach step now progresses past decrypt, evidence uploaded to s3 but scan pipeline still shows `evidence.missing=true` in metadata store
MariaG: metadata consumer expects `evidence_upload` event from keystore-attacher, maybe the attacher posted a partial success before hitting another permission check (kms:DescribeKey)
NatalieC: looking at key policy diff from the automation run — it removed the service role ARN under `Allow` for `kms:DescribeKey` and `kms:GetKeyPolicy`. That explains the DescribeKey failures
AlexW: who approved the automation change? the PR shows `infra-automation-bot` but no human approval record in the audit trail
JayOps: infra-automation-bot is on a scheduled run that applies `keystore-rotation` in staging then promotes. The promotion job requires LGTM but someone must've promoted via the pipeline token — investigating now
sec-bot: incident:keystore-rotation flagged — creating incident channel #incident/keystore-rotation-1712349999 :rotating_light:
SamirS: next actions: (a) re-add `ci-runner` role to key policy (b) add temporary allow for kms:Decrypt, kms:DescribeKey, kms:GetKeyPolicy (c) run meta backfill job (d) add a check in premerge SAST gate to fail-open with clearer message if evidence attachment fails
MariaG: Agree. Also we should update the runbook to include ephemeral-grant step and exact CLI commands; current runbook lacks `create-grant` example. I'll open a doc PR after we stabilize
NatalieC: I'll file a security review for the automation: confirm least-privilege, ensure promotions require two human approvals for keystore key-policy changes. We should treat key-policy changes as high-risk with mandatory human signoff
AlexW: patch for disabling retries is deployed (rollout ok). CI jobs requeued and currently 7/12 passing post-grant.
JayOps: I've reverted the policy delta in staging and applied to prod with emergency flag; verifying audit entries.
SamirS: once we confirm all evidence uploaded, we'll run a small eval to ensure SAST/DAST alerts surface correctly and link to the new audit log entries
MariaG: note for postmortem: include timeline, root cause (automation promoted change without approval), missing runbook step, and mitigation (ephemeral grant + policy revert + runbook update)
NatalieC: I've created a follow-up ticket in Zendesk / Jira: SEC-KESTORE-242 with tasks + owners (Samir, JayOps, Maria).
sec-bot: incident resolved -> severity lowered to P2. Logs: https://logs.redwood.example.org/keystore/1712349999/summary :white_check_mark:
AlexW: thanks everyone — still monitoring but good to close the thread after 24h stability window. :thumbsup:
